title: Prognostic value of members of NFAT family for pan-cancer and a prediction model based on NFAT2 in bladder cancer.
authors: Dai, Zhou-Tong; Xiang, Yuan; Wang, Yundan; Bao, Le-Yuan; Wang, Jun; Li, Jia-Peng; Zhang, Hui-Min; Lu, Zhongxin; Ponnambalam, Sreenivasan; Liao, Xing-Hua
one_liner_zh: 该文基于NFAT家族进行泛癌及膀胱癌预后分析并构建预测模型，属于纯临床预后与表达统计，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Bladder cancer (BLCA) is one of the common malignant tumors of the urinary system. The poor prognosis of BLCA patients is due to the lack of early diagnosis and disease recurrence after treatment. Increasing evidence suggests that gene products of the nuclear factor of activated T-cells (NFAT) family are involved in BLCA progression and subsequent interaction(s) with immune surveillance. In this study, we carried out a pan-cancer analysis of the NFAT family and found that NFAT2 is an independent prognostic factor for BLCA. We then screened for differentially expressed genes (DEGs) and further analyzed such candidate gene loci using gene ontology enrichment to curate the KEGG database. We then used Lasso and multivariate Cox regression to identify 4 gene loci (FER1L4, RNF128, EPHB6, and FN1) which were screened together with NFAT2 to construct a prognostic model based on using Kaplan-Meier analysis to predict the overall survival of BLCA patients. Moreover, the accuracy of our proposed model is supported by deposited datasets in the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database. Finally, a nomogram of this prognosis model for BLCA was established which could help to provide better disease management and treatment.
abstract_zh: 膀胱癌（BLCA）是泌尿系统常见的恶性肿瘤之一。BLCA患者预后不良的原因在于缺乏早期诊断以及治疗后疾病复发。越来越多的证据表明，活化T细胞核因子（NFAT）家族的基因产物参与BLCA的进展及其与免疫监视的后续相互作用。在本研究中，我们对NFAT家族进行了泛癌分析，并发现NFAT2是BLCA的独立预后因素。随后，我们筛选了差异表达基因（DEGs），并利用基因本体论富集分析进一步分析这些候选基因位点，以整理KEGG数据库。接着，我们使用Lasso和多变量Cox回归识别出4个基因位点（FER1L4、RNF128、EPHB6和FN1），这些位点与NFAT2一同被筛选出来，用于构建基于Kaplan-Meier分析的预后模型，以预测BLCA患者的总生存期。此外，我们提出的模型的准确性得到了基因表达综合（GEO）数据库中存储数据集的支持。最后，我们建立了该BLCA预后模型的列线图，这可能有助于提供更好的疾病管理和治疗。
